text: 市场全天高开回落，三大指数集体上涨。AI漫剧概念再度走强，文投控股、慈文传媒、掌阅科技、引力传媒等多股涨停。AI眼镜概念午后拉升，视涯科技、国光电器、亿道信息、瀛通通讯等涨停。机器人概念表现活跃，锋龙股份、光洋股份、天奇股份、襄阳轴承等涨停。下跌方面，油气股集体下挫，中国石油跌超6%。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超4200股飘红，今日成交逾1.51万亿。截止收盘沪指涨0.08%，深成指涨0.86%，创业板指涨1.46%。
text_en: The market opened higher and pulled back throughout the day, with all three major indices closing higher. The AI comic-drama concept strengthened again, with Cultural Investment Holdings, Ciwen Media, Zhangyue Technology, and Gravity Media among many stocks hitting the daily limit. The AI glasses concept rallied in the afternoon, with SeeYa Technology, Guoguang Electric, Emdoor Information, and Yingtong Communication hitting the daily limit. Robot-related stocks were active, with Fenglong, Guangyang, Tianqi, and Xiangyang Bearing hitting the daily limit. On the downside, oil and gas stocks fell collectively, with PetroChina down more than 6%. More stocks rose than fell, with over 4,200 stocks in Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing trading higher, and turnover today exceeded 1.51 trillion yuan. At the close, the Shanghai Composite was up 0.08%, the Shenzhen Component up 0.86%, and the ChiNext Index up 1.46%.
